breakdown.description: The prompt uses the twist limit directly in degrees inside a torsion formula that returns φ in radians unless the limit is converted.
breakdown.reason: The agent failed to resolve the inconsistency. The original prompt incorrectly instructed to use the angle of twist limit directly in degrees. The ground truth corrected this by removing the erroneous instruction. However, the generated specification repeated the error by stating, 'The angle-of-twist formula φ = T L / (J G) must be used directly with the angle in degrees.'
